_: The dashboard's English (#122). Every piece of text the page shows is a message here, asked for by its key; a catalog in another language (dashboard.<code>.json) carries the same keys, and a key it lacks comes out in English. A message takes {name} values and {n, plural, one {...} other {...}} forms ('#' in a form is n), may carry the page's own markup (<code>, <b>), and never names a card title, a log line or what an agent wrote: those are shown as written. docs/configuration.md says how to add a language; scripts/test/dashboard-catalog.test.sh checks every catalog against the keys the page uses.
